name: 34142 · Immokalee, FL
findings: ZIP 34142 (Immokalee) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34142 (Immokalee) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 34142 (Immokalee) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
